description: This file defines the CloudHsmClient class in the Aws\CloudHsm namespace, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with AWS CloudHSM services, including various resource management operations. It primarily sets up method signatures for API calls related to CloudHSM.

classes.name: CloudHsmClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS CloudHSM, providing methods for creating, deleting, describing, and managing HSM resources.

methods.name: addTagsToResource
methods.description: Adds tags to an AWS CloudHSM resource.

methods.name: createLunaClient
methods.description: Creates a Luna client for CloudHSM.

methods.name: describeHapg
methods.description: Provides details about a high-availability partition group.

methods.name: describeLunaClient
methods.description: Provides information about a Luna client.

methods.name: getConfigFiles
methods.description: Retrieves configuration files from the service.

methods.name: listAvailableZones
methods.description: Lists available zones for AWS CloudHSM.

methods.name: listHsms
methods.description: Lists the clusters being used with CloudHSM.

methods.name: modifyHapg
methods.description: Modifies an existing high-availability partition group.

methods.name: removeTagsFromResource
methods.description: Removes tags from an AWS CloudHSM resource.
